query:
UPDATE accounts SET (id, 
name, 
name_is_locked, 
status, 
addr, 
created_at, 
updated_at, 
claim_signature, 
claim_session_id, 
processed_for_legacy_claim, 
allows_gasless, 
acceptance_status, 
invited_by_account_id, 
invites_per_month, 
available_invites, 
invite_quota_last_replenished_at, 
lang, 
profile_pic, 
unclaimed_asami_balance, 
unclaimed_doc_balance, 
asami_balance, 
doc_balance, 
rbtc_balance, 
last_on_chain_sync, 
force_hydrate, 
total_collabs, 
total_collab_rewards, 
total_campaigns, 
total_collabs_received, 
total_spent) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE name END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE name_is_locked END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE status END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE addr END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE created_at END), (CASE $14::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $15 ELSE updated_at END), (CASE $16::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $17 ELSE claim_signature END), (CASE $18::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $19 ELSE claim_session_id END), (CASE $20::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $21 ELSE processed_for_legacy_claim END), (CASE $22::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $23 ELSE allows_gasless END), (CASE $24::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $25 ELSE acceptance_status END), (CASE $26::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $27 ELSE invited_by_account_id END), (CASE $28::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $29 ELSE invites_per_month END), (CASE $30::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $31 ELSE available_invites END), (CASE $32::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $33 ELSE invite_quota_last_replenished_at END), (CASE $34::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $35 ELSE lang END), (CASE $36::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $37 ELSE profile_pic END), (CASE $38::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $39 ELSE unclaimed_asami_balance END), (CASE $40::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $41 ELSE unclaimed_doc_balance END), (CASE $42::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $43 ELSE asami_balance END), (CASE $44::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $45 ELSE doc_balance END), (CASE $46::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $47 ELSE rbtc_balance END), (CASE $48::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $49 ELSE last_on_chain_sync END), (CASE $50::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $51 ELSE force_hydrate END), (CASE $52::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $53 ELSE total_collabs END), (CASE $54::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $55 ELSE total_collab_rewards END), (CASE $56::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $57 ELSE total_campaigns END), (CASE $58::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $59 ELSE total_collabs_received END), (CASE $60::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $61 ELSE total_spent END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: String", 
name as "name!: String", 
name_is_locked as "name_is_locked!: bool", 
status as "status!: AccountStatus", 
addr as "addr!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
updated_at as "updated_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
claim_signature as "claim_signature!: Option < String >", 
claim_session_id as "claim_session_id!: Option < String >", 
processed_for_legacy_claim as "processed_for_legacy_claim!: bool", 
allows_gasless as "allows_gasless!: bool", 
acceptance_status as "acceptance_status!: AcceptanceStatus", 
invited_by_account_id as "invited_by_account_id!: Option < String >", 
invites_per_month as "invites_per_month!: i32", 
available_invites as "available_invites!: i32", 
invite_quota_last_replenished_at as "invite_quota_last_replenished_at!: UtcDateTime", 
lang as "lang!: super :: Lang", 
profile_pic as "profile_pic!: Option < String >", 
unclaimed_asami_balance as "unclaimed_asami_balance!: String", 
unclaimed_doc_balance as "unclaimed_doc_balance!: String", 
asami_balance as "asami_balance!: String", 
doc_balance as "doc_balance!: String", 
rbtc_balance as "rbtc_balance!: String", 
last_on_chain_sync as "last_on_chain_sync!: UtcDateTime", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
total_collabs as "total_collabs!: i32", 
total_collab_rewards as "total_collab_rewards!: String", 
total_campaigns as "total_campaigns!: i32", 
total_collabs_received as "total_collabs_received!: i32", 
total_spent as "total_spent!: String"
